inputs.name: base-branch
inputs.description: Git ref to compare against. Default: the pull request's base branch, or the previous commit for a push.

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: `run` to select and run tests with pytest, or `select` to only compute the selection.

inputs.name: python
inputs.description: Python interpreter to use. It must have pytest and your project's dependencies installed (e.g. set up by actions/setup-python). Default: `python`, else `python3`.

inputs.name: pytest-args
inputs.description: Extra arguments for pytest, separated by spaces (e.g. `-x -n auto`).

inputs.name: working-directory
inputs.description: Directory of the Python project, relative to the repository root.

inputs.name: on-git-error
inputs.description: If changes cannot be determined: `fail`, or `run-all` to run the full suite.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: Extra arguments for Karma itself, separated by spaces (e.g. `--explain`).

inputs.name: prioritize
inputs.description: `true` to run the tests most likely to fail first, predicted from the recorded test history. Combine with `pytest-args: -x` to stop at the first failure.

inputs.name: granularity
inputs.description: `function` to run only the test functions and classes that use a changed function, class or constant (falling back to whole files wherever that cannot be decided safely); `file` for whole test files. Default: `granularity` in `[tool.karma]`, else `file`.

inputs.name: retries
inputs.description: Re-run failed tests up to this many times. A test that passes on retry is reported as flaky (a warning, not a failure) and recorded for `karma flaky sync`.

inputs.name: cache
inputs.description: `true` to keep `.karma_cache/` (import cache and test history) between runs with actions/cache, so history accumulates and graphs build faster.

inputs.name: diagnose
inputs.description: `true` to explain each failure in the job summary and on the diff: the changed lines in its traceback, why the test ran, and its history. Computed locally.

inputs.name: ai
inputs.description: Also ask a language model to explain failures: `anthropic` (set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the step's `env` from a secret), `ollama` or `openai` (any OpenAI-compatible server). Off by default; the model is sent each failure's traceback and diff.

inputs.name: ai-model
inputs.description: Model for `ai`; the default for `anthropic` is claude-sonnet-5.

outputs.name: test_files
outputs.description: Space-separated list of the selected test files

outputs.name: tests-run
outputs.description: Number of test files that were run

outputs.name: total-count
outputs.description: Number of test files in the project

outputs.name: run-all
outputs.description: `true` when a change (e.g. to pyproject.toml) selected the whole suite

outputs.name: flaky-tests
outputs.description: Space-separated node ids of tests that failed, then passed on retry
